meta.name: weekly-plan
meta.description: Plan weekly P-Tasks with in-repo task triage and overplanning challenge

copy.tagline: 规划每周任务并挑战过度计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每周需要整理仓库任务并制定计划
copy.tagline_en: Plan weekly tasks with in-repo triage and overplanning challenge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to triage repo tasks and plan your week

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你规划每周的 P-Tasks（3-5 个重要任务），包括回顾上周完成情况、分析近期日记和日历、整理任务清单、提出过度计划警告，并最终生成 Obsidian 格式的周计划文件和任务列表。
howto.when: 当你主动要求规划一周任务时触发，例如说“帮我规划本周”或“计划我的周任务”。通常在周日晚上或周一早上使用。

say.note: Claude 会开始回顾上周并分析你的日记和日历。

say.text: 我本周有这些任务：A、B、C，帮我验证一下
say.note: Claude 会检查任务质量并给出调整建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you plan weekly P-Tasks (3-5 important priorities) by reviewing last week's completion, analyzing recent journals and calendar, triaging task lists, issuing overplanning warnings, and generating Obsidian-formatted weekly plan files and task lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan your week, e.g., 'plan my week' or 'help me plan this week'. Typically used Sunday evening or Monday morning.

say_en.text: Help me plan this week's P-Tasks
I have these tasks this week: A, B, C. Please validate them.
say_en.note: Claude will check task quality and suggest adjustments.
